statements.statement: The patient has recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a recent history of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on failure to obtain required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is required to correlate potential arrhythmic events with neurological symptoms and guide further management
